Supply in: Boiler B6 30 mA RCBO
Reconstructed from the Dec 2018 notes; core colours from the Oct 2026 survey. 6-way rows as in the 2018 notes.
Every heating and hot-water demand opens a zone valve; only the valve end switches (orange) make the boiler switched live.
Row numbering follows the 2018 notes, which do not match the strip as surveyed in 2026; exact as-built positions are not recoverable.
